name: exec
command:
const r = await tools.exec_command({"cmd":"$root = '<PROJECT>\\script_vs_context_benchmark\\source_artifacts\\e2-n1000-v1'; $manifest = Get-Content -Raw (Join-Path $root 'manifest.json') | ConvertFrom-Json; 'raw_id,report_year,track_type,severity_class,valid_damage_usd,valid_injured,valid_hazmat'; foreach ($page in $manifest.pages) { Get-Content (Join-Path $root $page.file) | ForEach-Object { $row = $_ | ConvertFrom-Json; $damageText = [string]$row.damage_text; $injuredText = [string]$row.injured_text; $hazmatText = [string]$row.hazmat_released_text; $damage = if ($damageText -match '^\\d+$' -or $damageText -match '^[1-9]\\d{0,2}(?:,\\d{3})+$') { [Int64]($damageText -replace ',', '') } else { $null }; $injured = if ($injuredText -match '^\\d+$') { [Int64]$injuredText } else { $null }; $hazmat = if ($hazmatText -match '^\\d+$') { [Int64]$hazmatText } else { $null }; $severity = if ($null -eq $damage -or $null -eq $injured -or $null -eq $hazmat) { 'unknown' } elseif ($injured -gt 0 -or $hazmat -gt 0 -or $damage -ge 1000000) { 'critical' } elseif ($damage -ge 100000) { 'high' } elseif ($damage -ge 10000) { 'medium' } else { 'low' }; [string]::Join(',', @([string]$row.raw_id, [string]$row.report_year, [string]$row.track_type, $severity, $(if ($null -eq $damage) { '' } else { [string]$damage }), $(if ($null -eq $injured) { '' } else { [string]$injured }), $(if ($null -eq $hazmat) { '' } else { [string]$hazmat }))) } }","workdir":"<PROJECT>","yield_time_ms":30000,"max_output_tokens":60000});
text(r.output);
